output.rationale: The requirement specifies Metal Clad Switchgear that is arc-resistant Type 2B and compliant with IEEE C37.20.7 standards. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit matches these specifications as it is described as arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear meeting IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B standards. This makes it the appropriate choice for the requirement.
